flags.why: This meaning refers to turkey generally, including domestic turkeys, rather than specifically to wild turkey.
The use of gà lôi to mean turkey is mainly Southern Vietnamese.
The forest example suggests the pheasant meaning rather than demonstrating the Southern meaning turkey.
flags.fix: Nhà tôi nuôi gà lôi để bán lấy thịt. = My family raises turkeys to sell for meat.
